content.title: Muslims Day Launches Free Quran Mashq Classes ✨
content.subtitle: Register Now to Receive the Class Link
content.body:
We regularly receive a message through our customer support channel: “Why don't you add Bangla pronunciation alongside the Arabic text in the Quran section? It would make recitation much easier for us.”

We truly appreciate this heartfelt request. However, we have refrained from adding Bangla transliteration to the app. Do you know why?

When Incorrect Pronunciation Changes the Meaning

Reciting the required portions of the Quran correctly in Salah is Fard for every Muslim. Allah Almighty says:

“And recite the Quran with measured recitation.” (Surah Al-Muzzammil: 4).

The Limitations of Bangla Transliteration

The Quran was revealed in Arabic, and every Arabic letter has its specific Makharij (points of articulation) and Sifaat (characteristics). The subtle pronunciation of Arabic cannot be accurately represented through the Bangla alphabet. As a result, reading Arabic through Bangla transliteration can inevitably lead to changes in meaning.

How Serious Can Incorrect Recitation Be?

According to Islamic jurisprudence, a major recitation error (Lahn Jali) that completely changes the original meaning can invalidate Salah.

Similarly, knowingly continuing Salah with incorrect recitation is a serious matter. We have taken this precaution so that none of our brothers or sisters unknowingly become involved in such a sin in pursuit of convenience.

Our Responsibility Does Not End Here

Muslims Day holds a significant place in your trust and confidence. Therefore, out of our sense of responsibility, we have long wanted to find an alternative that could make your Quranic journey a little easier and more meaningful.

A New Initiative Inspired by Your Feedback

A few days ago, we shared a survey form to understand your opinions about learning to recite the essential Surahs of Salah correctly.

Based on your enthusiastic response and valuable feedback, we are pleased to announce that the first experimental Quran Mashq class will begin on Wednesday, November 11, at 6:15 AM, InshaAllah.

Meet Your Instructor

This special Quran Mashq session will be conducted by Hafiz Maulana Tawhidul Islam.

  • Educational Qualification: Takmil (Dawrah-e-Hadith), Jamiatul Uloomil Islamia Dhaka, Mohammadpur.

Limited Seats: Register Now!

As the number of seats is limited, participants will be selected on a priority basis. Those who register early will receive the opportunity to join the class first.
